defects_found_this_cycle.issue: File is stored UTF-16 LE with BOM but declares <meta charset="UTF-8"> and GitHub Pages serves it as text/html; charset=utf-8. A parser trusting the declared charset sees NUL-interleaved garbage. Verified: a UTF-8 decode of the live bytes does NOT match the meta tag, while a UTF-16 decode does.
defects_found_this_cycle.impact: This is the ONLY page carrying the google-site-verification meta tag, so Search Console ownership verification is unreliable on this page.
defects_found_this_cycle.secondary: The <meta charset> declaration sits at byte offset 1546, past the 1024-byte limit the HTML spec sets.
defects_found_this_cycle.status: NOT FIXED - requires an encoding decision on the founder dashboard; not changed autonomously.

defects_found_this_cycle.issue: google-site-verification meta tag is present on the root index.html only; it is absent from all 59 customer-facing pages. Harmless for a URL-prefix property (the tag must appear on the property root), but recorded so it is not mistaken for a distributed tag.

security_disclosure.issue: During Gumroad API pagination debugging, a requests InvalidURL exception printed a URL that contained the access_token, to the operator terminal only. It was not written to any repo file, log, or committed artifact. Recorded here rather than silently dropped. Recommended action: rotate GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN if the operator considers terminal history sensitive.
